_comment: EXAMPLE — fictional entries. Copy to retired.json and list things that are RETIRED/DEAD but that tooling docs might still describe as live. Archived app directories are derived from disk (archived_app_globs in doctor.config.json) and must NOT be listed here. Add a row the day you retire something — that is the whole maintenance cost of this check. A row names the thing that died (the container, the server), never the whole category (the runtime) — otherwise every correct mention of the live replacement fires.
